newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO SAYS HAS $135 MLN REVOLVING LOAN.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO SAYS HAS $135 MLN REVOLVING LOAN.

text.p: Finnish foods, animal feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said on Friday it had made a $135 million multi-currency revolving loan agreement with a group of Finnish and foreign financial institutions.
"Raision Tehtaat Oy, the parent company of the Raisio group has made a $135 million multi-currency revolving loan agreement with an international banking group," Raisio said in a statement.
The loan -- Raisio's first international agreement of this kind -- was arranged by Merita Bank and four Finnish and eleven foreign financial institutions will take part, Raisio said.
Raisio's CEO Matti Salminen said the revolving loan provides Rasio with an opportunity to handle its future financing needs flexibly, for example in conjunction with capital outlays.
Funds borrowed within the framework of the agreement can also be used to replace earlier loans, Raisio said.
"Our liquidity is good, and we have no immediate need to borrow," it said.
"Nevertheless, we felt it was a good time to conclude the revolving loan agreement," it added.
